g.text: Floor -0.48 m. Nominal clear height 2.22 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
An axial procession leads from the command canopy through a receiving room and moon court to the ring gallery. Two
private suites open off the court. The display garden stays to port of the walking line.
